notes: Board decision eff. 2023-06-01: 20-min/cancel compensation on ALL traffic incl. Oresundstag to/from Denmark. Voluntary term ABOVE the legal floor, so route distance is irrelevant -> single 0-inf band. Tiers 50/75/100 pct at 20/40/60 min.
SJ journeys UNDER 150 km fall under the Swedish regional regime (Lag 2015:953): 50/75/100 pct at 20/40/60 min, cancellations claimable. Distance band, not operator, sets the regime (per-journey).

SJ journeys 150 km or longer fall under EU 2021/782: 25 pct at 60-119 min, 50 pct at 120+ min, cancellations claimable. 60-min trigger = regulation floor. Verify against SJ resegaranti before enforcing.

SL (Storstockholms Lokaltrafik), Stockholm regional/local. Lag 2015:953 regional regime (20-min + cancel), all SL traffic is short-distance -> single 0-inf band. Filed via SL no-BankID web form, 2-month window.

Snalltaget journeys under 150 km: regional regime 50/75/100 pct at 20/40/60 min. Same distance-band split as SJ; rare for a commercial long-distance operator. Verify Snalltaget terms before enforcing.
Snalltaget journeys 150 km or longer: EU 2021/782 25/50 pct at 60/120 min. 60-min trigger = regulation floor. Verify Snalltaget terms before enforcing.
